test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the double of the lower limit of the modal class of the given data:

 
 

 CI
 100-110
 110-120
 120-130
 130-140
 140-150
 
 

 F
 12
 15
 32
 34
 22
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Data with class intervals and their respective frequencies.

**Concept used:**

 
• Mode is the class interval with the highest frequency.

**Calculations:**

We know that,

Mode is given with the highest frequency,

So, the class interval having the highest frequency is 130-140.

The lower limit of this class interval is 130.

According to the question,

Double of the lower limit is 2 ✖ 130 =260.

Therefore, **the correct answer is option 3 i.e. 260.**
